resolved_findings.title: Reuse the existing Hausdorff-distance prerequisite
resolved_findings.detail: The page defines Hausdorff distance without linking the canonical atomic definition 00FN, although that definition already exists. This defeats deduplication and omits the nonempty compact-set domain. Use 00FN for the definition, state that the limiting compact K is nonempty, and retain the distinction between the displayed weaker thickened-set conjecture and the source's stronger dilation conjecture.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Link Hausdorff distance to 00FN and record it in prerequisites; remove the redundant full definition or keep only a clearly labelled recall.
resolved_findings.resolution: Re-read repaired 4G0J: canonical 00FN reused, K explicitly nonempty compact, finite-time infected-region bound supplied, and weaker Hausdorff conjecture still distinguished from source dilation claim.

resolved_findings.title: Send the total-variation terminology link to its definition
resolved_findings.detail: The link labelled 全变差距离 lands on 4G0H (mixing time/cutoff), rather than the coordinated canonical definition 4F27. The notation d_L belongs to 4G0H, but the named definition does not.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Link 全变差距离 to 4F27, or relabel the existing 4G0H link 最坏初态距离/混合截断; retain true prerequisite edges.
resolved_findings.resolution: Re-read repaired 4G0I: 4F27 is the TV definition and 4G0H is correctly labelled worst-initial-state distance; packet registers both.

resolved_findings.title: Square the distance in the diffusion heuristic
resolved_findings.detail: The prose says to divide the typical distance q^(-1/d) by the diffusion speed, but the displayed q^(-(1+2/d)) comes from the squared distance divided by the jump rate q. The wording teaches ballistic instead of diffusive scaling even though the final exponent is correct.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Write the heuristic explicitly as (q^(-1/d))^2/q = q^(-(1+2/d)), and describe q as the jump-rate or diffusivity scale.
resolved_findings.resolution: Re-read repaired 4G0M: the displayed diffusion heuristic now explicitly squares the typical distance and divides by rate q.

resolved_findings.title: Keep the comparison-cost statement as an upper bound
resolved_findings.detail: The formulas and cited Proposition 4.5 assert upper bounds on the comparison constants; the subsequent phrase 第一种代价的对数为...量级 reads as a matching two-sided order, which is not established there.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Say the logarithmic cost is at most that order (and the symmetric cost at most polynomial), unless a separate matching lower bound is supplied.
resolved_findings.resolution: Re-read repaired 4G15: both costs are described only as upper bounds, consistent with the displayed inequalities.

resolved_findings.title: Introduce the density and dimension locally
resolved_findings.detail: The stationary-state conjecture uses q and Z^d without locally fixing d>=1 and 0<q<1. The update-family link does not bind parameters for this page, and endpoint q=0 or 1 changes the equilibrium interpretation.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Begin by fixing d>=1 and 0<q<1 before defining the update family and mu.
resolved_findings.resolution: Re-read repaired 4G0D: d>=1 and 0<q<1 introduced locally; zero-probability conditioning caution and conjectural status preserved.

resolved_findings.title: Account for the updated site's old value in backward queries
resolved_findings.detail: The backwards construction counts only the M constraint-neighbor choices. At an illegal ring the updated site retains its old value, so recursively determining that update also requires the same site's value before the ring. With the currently defined M, the stated bound does not account for this self branch. A finite branching bound still proves the result, but it must describe all queried coordinates.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Use a branching bound M+1 (or define a new bound that explicitly includes the updated coordinate), explain the old-value query at failed rings, and retain the factorial time-ordering bound. Alternatively explicitly define a compressed influence-path construction and justify the different count.
resolved_findings.resolution: Re-read final 4G03: M is the cardinality of the union of constraint neighbors, retained old values are explicit self queries, and the safe M+1 branching factor appears in the factorial time-order bound.

resolved_findings.title: Bind the random initialization and density in standalone universality notes
resolved_findings.detail: 4G0W's probability statement uses q and tau_0^BP without introducing a Bernoulli(q) infected set or the limit q down to zero on this page. Likewise 4G0Y introduces q, mu_q and the hitting times only in its research formulas; 4G0X uses mu_q without locally defining it. An update-family definition alone does not bind these random data in a separately reusable note.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Before the time-scale claims in 4G0W, 4G0X and 4G0Y, fix 0<q<1, specify iid vacancy density q (equivalently mu_q=Bernoulli(1-q) product), distinguish bootstrap infection time from KCM hitting time where both occur, and state q down to zero.
resolved_findings.resolution: Re-read final 4G0W, 4G0X and 4G0Y: each now binds 0<q<1 and the Bernoulli product initialization; applicable discrete bootstrap and continuous KCM hitting times are locally specified, q tends to zero explicitly, and mean versus high-probability statements remain distinct.

The finite generator/uniformization, heat-bath identities and Dirichlet normalization, variance tensorization, finite killed-chain estimate, closure-class argument, concrete geometry, BABP duality, path comparison, fixed-endpoint variance bound and finite projection are consistent on their stated domains. The backward-query construction now accounts for self retention. Numerical spot checks are corroboration only.

Heuristics, cited research inputs, local deductions and conjectures remain distinguished.
checks.source_corrections: The notes' removal of the spurious 1/2 in conditional-variance sums and replacement of delta_all-empty by product equilibrium in East stationary classification are supported by direct calculation and the fixed supplementary v1.
